title: 동네 병원 접수대에서: 처음 왔어요
summary: A first visit to a neighborhood clinic: check in and wait for your turn.
objective: Check in at a clinic: say '처음 왔어요', give your name, birth date and ID, say why you came with '-이/가 아파서 왔어요', and understand '이름 부르면 들어가세요'.
setting: The reception desk (접수대) of a small neighborhood clinic. Maria is here for the first time with a sore throat.

dialogue.meaning: Hello. Is this your first visit?
Yes, it's my first time here.

dialogue.korean: 생년월일 말씀해 주세요. 신분증도 보여 주세요.
dialogue.meaning: Please tell me your date of birth. Please show me your ID, too.
It's March 14, 1998. Here's my residence card.
Thank you. What brings you in today?

dialogue.korean: 목이 아파서 왔어요. 열도 좀 있어요.
dialogue.meaning: I came because I have a sore throat. I have a bit of a fever, too.

dialogue.korean: 네, 앉아서 기다리세요. 이름 부르면 들어가세요.
dialogue.meaning: Okay, have a seat and wait. Go in when we call your name.

words.exampleMeaning: Please write your date of birth here.
Next time, be sure to bring your ID.

words.meaning: I came because my ... hurts (이 after a consonant, 가 after a vowel)
words.exampleMeaning: I came because my lower back hurts.

task.title: Check in at the clinic
task.line: Fill in the blank or choose the best answer.

exercises: The receptionist asks '전에 오신 적 있으세요?' (Have you been here before?). You have never been here: 아니요, ____ ____.
Add the body part and the right particle (이 or 가). My foot (발) hurts: ____ 아파서 왔어요. / My ear (귀) hurts: ____ 아파서 왔어요.
Choose the right reply to the receptionist's question '성함이 어떻게 되세요?': (a) 제임스 박이에요. (b) 스물다섯 살이에요. (c) 감기에 걸렸어요.
Fill in the blank. The receptionist asks '신분증 좀 보여 주시겠어요?' You hand over your residence card: 네, ____ 여기 있어요.
The receptionist says '이름 부르면 들어가세요.' What should you do? (a) Go in right now. (b) Wait, then go in when your name is called. (c) Write your name and go home.
answers: (b) Wait, then go in when your name is called.
